title: Puzzle2d Brush Tool
description: Implement paint-style Brush tool for puzzle2d: offset slot hitboxes, compatible node preview, auto-flush on leave, Tab cycle candidates, flush-distance window measure.
summary: Fixed brush not committing on cursor leave: replay deferred brush pointer leave/move after GPU frame when WASM session was blocked, commit preview on brush pointer-up in WASM, pass fixture kindCompatibility to play canvases, added React integration test brushPlace fires when pointer leaves brush slot. Rebuilt puzzle_2d WASM.
